title: Lekishi historical contract v0: source document
description: A cited work, dataset, or media asset with its reuse terms. Publication requires recorded licenses for every cited source; an unrecorded license blocks publication rather than assuming reuse is permitted. A source document is immutable once a publication set pins it: correcting metadata means publishing a new source document (with a new source_id and an optional supersedes_source_id) and republishing the citing records, so the previously approved metadata is preserved rather than overwritten.

source_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical encoding of this document without source_hash. Publication sets pin this value.

supersedes_source_id.description: Set on a new source document that replaces an earlier one, so the identity relationship is explicit rather than implied by a similar title.
